verdict.rationale: Codex documents a `codex --image` flag for passing a design reference with the first prompt or pasting an image into the composer, and it can edit files and run commands in a repository, so image-to-code generation is a direct but thinly documented capability. Nothing shows sketch-to-working-app results or PDF design input; Figma access through MCP is an adjacent integration and earns no credit. missing for 10: PDF design input, documented end-to-end design-to-working-app workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of app generation from images or sketches.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design

citations.quote: Pass an error screenshot, architecture diagram, or design reference with the first prompt, or paste an image into the interactive composer.
Start Codex in a repository to explore unfamiliar code, plan a change, edit files, and run your local development tools.
